notable_absence.finding: This batch's specific question - whether the per-service metrics catalog structure reveals anything about the service-dependency graph not already captured - is answered here: no. This index page, and every per-service metrics page in this batch, is a flat list of Prometheus metric names with a version badge, a type/unit badge, and a one-line description. None of them contain prose describing service-to-service architectural dependencies (the kind of statement that produced service:index-service dependsOnService service:data-service in the server/ services-and-indexes round). The metric name prefixes (kv_, n1ql_, index_, fts_, cbas_, eventing_, xdcr_, cm_/generic names) implicitly signal originating component, but that is a naming convention, not a documented dependency.

cross_component_finding: This page's own categorization sentence - 'Metrics are provided for all Couchbase Services, and also for the Cluster Manager and XDCR' - draws a three-way taxonomic line: (1) 'Services' (Data, Query, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics - reusing the existing service: namespace), (2) the Cluster Manager, and (3) XDCR, with the latter two explicitly NOT counted among 'the Services'. This is a genuine, source-stated structural distinction worth preserving verbatim rather than folding Cluster Manager/XDCR into service: by convenience.
